exit_criteria: Every fitted instance has an exact symbol, footprint, MPN, value, contact map and owning sheet.
Every intentional no-connect is named and justified.
ERC has no unexplained errors or warnings.
Reset, boot, recovery, power-off isolation, quiet state and FAULT_KILL pass independent review.
The generated HW-to-FW contract contains no invented pins and is accepted by firmware F2.
No schematic action is represented as PCB placement, routing, fabrication or purchase authorization.
